verdict.rationale: The evidence pack is entirely vendor-authored documentation, vendor GitHub repos (open-source reference implementations by Visa itself), and vendor MCP/toolkit releases; there is no evidence that any independent third party (merchant, platform, or agent developer unaffiliated with Visa) has actually implemented the Intelligent Commerce or Trusted Agent Protocol on their own systems. Community commentary is skeptical/speculative about future adoption rather than confirming existing independent implementations.
